items.title: Michi Fuji interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well welcome to Hamilton. My name is Monk Rowe and I’m pleased to have Michi Fuji here today on the campus.

ctx.x: Michi was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 3, 2014 by Monk Rowe, director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
Well welcome to Hamilton. My name is Monk Rowe and I’m pleased to have Michi Fuji here today on the campus. I enjoyed your playing a lot last night.
